newsitem.title: USA: Fingerhut estimates flat Q3 net, lower revs.
newsitem.headline: Fingerhut estimates flat Q3 net, lower revs.

text.p: Fingerhut Companies Inc, which sells products through catalogs and television, said Tuesday it expects to report 1996 third quarter earnings about the same as last year on lower revenues.
Fingerhut said it estimates its 1996 third quarter earnings at $8.6 million or $0.18 a share, equal to the $8.6 million and $0.18 earned in the same period a year ago.
Revenues for the third quarter are estimated at $441.9 million, down from $469.5 million in the 1995 third quarter.
Third quarter results are in line with analysts estimates, said Fingerhut Chairman Ted Deikel said in a statement.

As a result of efforts to reduce mailing and increase profitability, net sales for the 13-week period fell 12.7 percent to $346.4 million from $397.0 million in the 1995 third quarter, he said in a statement.

Finance income and other revenues for the quarter increased 31.6 percent to $95.4 million from $72.5 million in the comparable 1995 period. The increase was due to net revenues from MasterCard accounts issued by Direct Merchants Credit Card Bank, a subisidiary of Metris Companies Inc.
In the 1996 third quarter, Metris, a Fingerhut subsidiary, generated net income of $5.8 million or $0.12 a share. At Septebmer 30, 1996, Metris had managed receivables of $1.3 billion.

For the 39 weeks to September 27, 1996, Fingerhut said its net revenues fell 3.9 percent to $1.29 billion from $1.34 billion last year. Net sales decreased to $1.04 billion from $1.16 billion. Earnings per share declined to $0.18 from $0.42 in the year ago period.
